laws.rule: Missing receipts do not establish no effect
Same logical identity with changed effect conflicts
Developer owns business identity; attempts are not intents
Predispatch markers do not establish provider commit
Temporary absence and unavailable truth do not authorize execution
Unsupported or ambiguous shapes fail closed
Credentials are excluded from identities, effects, receipts and logs
Candidates cannot alter laws, evaluation or promotion
Restart preserves shared durable state; local authority is one machine
Only reviewed authoritative read-only reconciliation resolves uncertainty
